protocol_metadata.about: Blast Bridge is the canonical deposit and withdrawal bridge for the Blast Layer 2, an EVM-compatible Optimistic Rollup built on the OP Stack. Users deposit ETH or ERC-20/ERC-721 tokens from Ethereum mainnet into Blast's L1 escrow contracts; bridged assets are represented on the Blast L2 chain. A distinctive feature is that deposited ETH and stablecoins are automatically reinvested into yield-generating protocols (Lido stETH for ETH, MakerDAO DSR for stablecoins), with yield passed back to L2 users. Withdrawals from L2 back to L1 require a 7-day finalization period and involve the OptimismPortal prove/finalize flow.
